svg.metadata: Ferrosift investor review v01; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Belt path, support and drive
svg.text: FERROSIFT / ENGINEERING
Belt path, support and drive
Selected mechanical layout / covers removed for visibility / sizes are not strength-checked
CONCEPT ONLY
NOT FOR FABRICATION
BELT / FRAME / DRIVE SIDE / guards omitted from this view / 1:15
3000 MAIN DRUM CENTRES
2300 LOWER IDLER CENTRES
BASE ISOMETRIC / actual CAD solids / no manufacturing scale
BELT PATH SELECTION
Main drums: diameter 100, centres z=944. Belt thickness 6. Lower
idlers: diameter 80, centres z=570. Lower belt outer bottom
SENSOR KEEP-OUT
The lowered return run clears the induction housing at
z=780..980. The nonconductive window spans x=1350..1850;
placeholder thickness 6 requires deflection and wear tests.
DRIVE AND TENSION
Motor, gearbox, bearings, shafts, tension screws and mounts are
modeled packaging selections. Motor torque, belt tension,
tracking authority and bearing life are not calculated.
RELEASE INPUTS
Define maximum piece mass, impact/load cases, belt construction
and joint, roller crown, shaft/bearing fits, drive duty and
restart torque before detailing fabrication.
PROTECTION
Guard and access-panel geometry is a concept allowance. Nip
clearances, interlocks, isolation, emergency functions and dust
controls require a competent machinery review.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
